_readme: Every number in this file is written by code (eval/run_eval.py, bench/load_test.py, bench/summarize_logs.py). A section with status 'not_run' contains NO numbers on purpose.

eval.reason: No evaluation documents or GROQ_API_KEY were available when the project was built, so no retrieval/answer/citation/refusal/baseline metric has been measured.
reproduce: python -m eval.make_eval_set   # drafts questions; review by hand -> eval/dataset.jsonl (reviewed: true)

load.reason: Needs a running server with a real GROQ_API_KEY, gunicorn and a stated hardware spec; none available when the project was built.
reproduce: python -m bench.load_test --url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --doc eval/docs/<doc> --questions eval/dataset.jsonl --users 1 5 20 --duration 60 --server-hardware '<describe machine>'
